title: Milestone Score Deduction on Collectible Pickup
explanation: Across frames 386 to 1733, collecting coins after reaching 500 points caused score to decrease by 10 points instead of increasing by 100 points. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L40-L41 where bug_milestone_score_tax deducts 10 points on subsequent score gains, violating monotonic score progression.
repro_hint: Reach 500 points and collect additional coins or stomp enemies; each awards -10 points.
